subject: maths
question: At what rate percentage per annum will ₹14,400 amount to ₹15,876 in one year, if interest is compounded half-yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 14,400

Amount = 15,876

Time = 1 year

**Concept:**

when interest in compounded half yearly, then time is multiplied by 2 and rate is divided by 2.

A = P(1 + r/100)t

where A, P, r and t are amount, principal, rate and time respectively.

**Calculation:**

Time = 2 (i.,e. 1 × 2)

15,876 = 14,400(1 + r/100)²

⇒ 15,876/14,400 = (1 + r/100)²

⇒ √15,876/√14,400 = (1 + r/100)

⇒ 126/120 = (1 + r/100)

⇒ 126/120 = 1 + r/100

⇒ 126/120 = (100 + r)/100

⇒ (126 × 100)/120 = 100 + r

⇒ 105 = 100 + r

⇒ 105 - 100 = r

⇒ 5% = r

As, interest is compounded half yearly. So,rate will be double 10%. (i.e. 5 × 2).

**∴ Rate of interest is 10% .**
